summary: This file is the front door of the documents package. It makes a few key names easy to import from one place.
purpose: Lets other code write one short import line to reach the document types and the main extraction functions.
why: Likely reason: it keeps callers from needing to know which internal file defines each name.
how: It loads the document data types, the fact extraction functions, and the main document extraction function, then lists the public names in one list.
inputs: None directly. It runs when another part of the program first imports the documents package.
outputs: Makes the listed names available to other code.
risks: Adding a name to the public list without importing it, or renaming an internal function, will break imports for every caller.
debug: If an import of the documents package fails, check that the named file still defines each listed name and that no import loops back into this file.
